## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The running status should preserve the existing twelve-character revision identifier so deployments remain distinguishable and match their history entries. Tests were read, not run.

## Changes
The pull request adds running deployment output with a shortened revision and attempt number, plus tests for the output format and attempt labels.

## Important
- app/display.py:14 — correctness — Use the history revision width in running status — For `0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567`, `status()` prints `0123456` while history prints `0123456789ab`. The docstring promises “the same identifier as history,” but `revision[:7]` differs from `history()`’s `revision[:12]`. — Running deployments with matching seven-character prefixes become indistinguishable even when history and completion distinguish their twelve-character identifiers. — Fix: Use `revision[:12]` and extend `test_running_status_contains_attempt` to verify the revision identifier.
